about: the fixture swot_gauge_baton_rouge_2024.json and what marks an unusable width
text: Seen while exploring. The pass of 2024-02-12 reports a width of 937.3 m, 89.0 m above its own track's line on stage and 116.5 m wider than the pass of the next day at a stage 0.122 m higher, while its height agrees with the gauge (departure +0.083 m from the median difference). Nothing the file keeps marks it: dark_frac 0.015, reach_q 1, stated height uncertainty 0.094 m. The file has no width_u, which the signed river and lake page says the granule carries; whether width_u is large on that pass cannot be seen. The other way round, the pass of 2024-03-26 (dark_frac 0.692, height +0.947 m off) has a width 29.9 m below its track's line. So in this year a wrong width and a wrong height came together once and apart twice (2024-02-12 width only, 2024-10-30 height only). Three passes fix no rate. Asking the fetch script to keep width_u, cycle and pass number would let the next reader see more; the drafted fixture page in the queue (not signed) already asks for cycle and pass.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
